briefing:
Good morning from Kurnool — here is your Monday briefing for 23 November 2026.

Weather: Currently mainly clear at 28.4 C with light winds. Today's high is 33.2 C, low 23.2 C, with no rain expected — enjoy the dry day before drizzle moves in tomorrow (65% chance) and Wednesday (73% chance).

News:

Stocks:
- Asian stock markets tumbled as fears of an AI bubble weighed on investor sentiment.
- U.S. stocks closed mostly lower after Nvidia's earnings failed to calm market nerves.
- U.S. futures bounced modestly even as an AI-driven rout continued to rattle Asian markets.

Technology:
- L&T Technology Services launched SDVault.ai, a new platform aimed at software-defined vehicles.
- Bill Gates visited Andhra Pradesh to discuss the role of technology in governance and public health.
- A new EY report explores how businesses can unlock stronger returns on AI investments in the tech sector.
